company.name: Hulu
company.shortDescription: American television shows the day after they air, plus movies and Hulu's own series.
company.planHelp: On a computer go to hulu.com, sign in, click your name in the top right corner and choose Account. Your plan is shown at the top under Your Subscription, with a Manage Plan link next to it. In the Hulu app, tap your profile picture, then Account.

sources.title: Watch Hulu without ads – Hulu (No Ads) pricing
Stream TV and Movies Live and Online | Hulu
Hulu + Live TV plans and pricing

features.label: No advertisements
features.question: Do you want to watch without advertisements?
features.help: The cheaper Hulu plan plays advertisements before and during shows. Even on the more expensive plan, a small number of series still carry advertisements.

features.label: Save shows to watch without internet
features.question: Do you save shows onto a phone or tablet to watch where there is no internet?

features.label: People who can watch at the same time
features.question: How many people watch at the same time?
features.help: Hulu allows two at once on both plans. If you need more, Hulu sells an Unlimited Screens extra with its Live TV service.

features.label: Live television channels
features.question: Do you want live television channels, like the ones you get with cable or an antenna?
features.help: The ordinary Hulu plans do not include live channels. Hulu sells a separate, much more expensive package called Hulu + Live TV for that.

plans.name: Hulu (With Ads)
plans.bestFor: People who want next-day American television at the lowest price and do not mind advertisements.
plans.notes: Prices 11.99 per month and 119.99 per year are confirmed on Hulu's own pages; paying yearly saves about 16 percent. Marked uncertain because Hulu's help pages about saving shows for offline viewing could not be read (they load their text only in a web browser), so whether this plan allows downloads is recorded as null rather than guessed.

plans.name: Hulu (No Ads)
plans.bestFor: People who watch a lot of Hulu and do not want to sit through advertisements.
plans.notes: Price 18.99 per month is confirmed on Hulu's own no-advertisements page, which also describes saving shows for offline viewing as a feature of this plan. A small number of series still show advertisements because of the deals behind them. Hulu does not advertise an annual version of this plan.

faq.q: Does Hulu include live television channels?
faq.a: Not on the ordinary plans. For live channels you need Hulu + Live TV, which is a separate and much more expensive package – 89.99 a month with advertisements on Hulu's library, or 99.99 a month without. Those prices also include Disney+ and ESPN Select.

faq.q: Can I save money by paying for a year at once?
faq.a: Yes, on the plan with advertisements. It costs 119.99 for twelve months instead of 11.99 each month, which saves about 16 percent.

faq.q: How many people can watch at the same time?
faq.a: Two screens at once. With Hulu + Live TV you can pay extra for an Unlimited Screens option that allows more devices at home.

faq.q: Is it cheaper to get Hulu with Disney+?
faq.a: Usually yes. Disney+ and Hulu together, both with advertisements, cost 12.99 a month, which is only a little more than Hulu on its own.

notes: Hulu + Live TV is recorded here for information only and is NOT modelled as a plan: 89.99 per month for Hulu (with ads) plus Disney+ and ESPN Select, or 99.99 per month for the version without advertisements on Hulu's library. Both include over 100 live channels, unlimited recording, and two screens at a time, with an extra-cost Unlimited Screens option. Bundle prices seen on Hulu's site: Disney+ and Hulu both with ads 12.99 per month; both without ads 19.99 per month; Disney+, Hulu and ESPN Select 21.99 per month (premium version 32.99); Disney+, Hulu and ESPN Unlimited 35.99 per month (premium 44.99); student bundle 6.49 per month. Hulu's help center pages could not be read directly because their text loads only inside a web browser; all figures above come from Hulu's public marketing pages.
